Settings resize the canvas only by default. Explicit content scaling rejects unsupported transforms.
Slide positions are one-based. Shape names are exact; numeric strings are names.
Duplicate names require --all. Default scope: slides.
Scopes: slides, notes, layouts, masters, notes-master, handout-master,
        presentation, shared.
Use --json to obtain reusable fingerprinted selector tokens.
XML operations also accept --select TOKEN instead of --part/--scope.
XML get reads package metadata with --part URI --scope shared.
Input '-' reads stdin; '--' ends options. Output - writes package bytes.
--limit NAME=VALUE lowers maxBytes, maxNodes, maxDepth or maxOutputBytes.
Repeat --limit for distinct names; output requires at least 512 bytes.
XML get emits original bytes; --pretty labels formatted output.
XML set validates before publication; supported existing drawing/run children
may be reordered or removed. Opaque content and resource bindings are retained.
Semantic checks are partial, not full schema validation.
Create defaults: empty deck, 12192000 x 6858000 EMUs, blank layout and master.
Lengths require emu, in, cm, mm or pt. Dates/authors are never synthesized.
Create supports Transitional only; supplied templates are unavailable.
Slides move/set/remove/duplicate also accept --selection-json QUERY_OR_ARRAY instead of simple selectors.
Section/show memberships are pruned automatically on slide removal.
Other affected known references require --reference-policy remove; opaque targets are rejected.
Import source-slides is an ordered JSON array of unique one-based positions.
Merge sources use --sources '[{"vfsPath":"source.pptx"}]'.
Merge applies source-slides to each source, or imports all when omitted.
Split names slide-NNNNNN.pptx follow emitted order; outward slide links fail.
Split requires an atomic adapter or explicit --allow-partial-output.
Import preserves source appearance by default; destination theme mapping is unavailable.
Import rejects conflicting notes masters, global font/text/table-style dependencies, unselected slide links and opaque references.
Dimension conflicts reject by default; destination policy retains source coordinates and destination size.
Slides add requires an exact layout name or part URI; position defaults to append.
Title/body match placeholder types; indexed bindings use --placeholders-json.

Usage: pptx images replace INPUT --slide N --image N --file PATH [output]
Selection: --scope SCOPE --slide N --image N | --select TOKEN | --all
  --allow-empty permits an empty selection. Positions are one-based.
Scopes: slides (default), layouts, masters, notes, notes-master, handout-master.
  shared scope requires --shared. Opaque and simple selectors cannot be mixed.
Default: clone and rebind selected occurrences.
  --shared replaces the resource and reports every occurrence across scopes.
Policies: --preserve-crop true|false --preserve-geometry true|false
  --preserve-alt-text true|false; all preservation policies default to true.
  --alt-text TEXT overrides the description. False crop clears cropping.
  False geometry uses native size at origin; false alt text clears description/title.
Input: --content-type image/png|image/jpeg|image/gif|image/bmp|image/tiff|image/x-wmf
  Otherwise inferred from extension. Links and vector/fallback pairs are rejected.
  Media parts owning relationships are also outside this replacement profile.
Output: --output PATH | --in-place; --force --dry-run --json --limit NAME=VALUE
Shared reports include masters and notes referencing the selected resource.
